Size $50m of the $100m gross cap: enough to clear the 3.85% SOFR funding vig if Mar-27 CORRA catch-up of ~25-38bp toward Jun/Sep 2027 CRA mids arrives, while leaving room because CA labor 38, core-near-2%, and +84bp already in CRAH27 cut conviction. events.invalidation: CORRA_2027-03 back to the 2.775 Dec-26 3m mid or confirmed on-hold with core near 2% and fading oil.
events.rationale: FACT: Global tightening is live (Fed +25bp, BoJ to 1.25%, BoE 6-3 with three hike votes) while US growth gauges and cyclical assets (copper, SPX, tight HY, low VIX) are not in recession. Canada is priced as the exception: CORRA 2.29, 1m path +29bp by year-end, and a 17 Sep sovereign rally. INFERENCE: energy pass-through plus activity 66 make that exception too large; Mar-27 CORRA should move toward the already-higher Jun/Sep 2027 CRA mids as BoC catch-up is pulled forward. That is the pro-growth/cyclical expression: the laggard cyclical central bank, not long AUD after a housing slump or long NZD with labor 32 and no NZ rates. UNKNOWN: whether Saudi supply workaround and core-near-2% CPI let BoC wait through Q1.

events.invalidation: Canadian activity follows labor lower or core/headline ease enough for BoC to keep overnight near 2.29 and reprice March 2027 CORRA down.
events.rationale: FACT: Canada is still running overnight CORRA at 2.29 with headline inflation at 3.0%, while CRAH27 prices only 3.13 and the Fed has already hiked to 3.75-4.00% with SOFR at 3.85. FACT: CA activity is 66 on a Q2 GDP rebound and stronger Ivey PMI; US activity/labor/inflation gauges are 69/75/72. INFERENCE: pessimism about Canadian labor (score 38, employment -42k) is over-discounted as a reason to keep the 2027H1 path capped; a resilient global cycle plus BoC energy-pass-through risk should lift the March 2027 implied rate. UNKNOWN: CFTC/CME positioning and any post-cutoff BoC communication. The pro-growth expression is to pay that still-limited Canada path, not to buy already-high AUD or fade USD.

events.invalidation: Close or reverse if CRAH27 paper mid trades at or through CRAZ26 2.735, or if oil/risk confirms demand destruction rather than Hormuz/Petroline supply, or if BoC communication caps or cuts from cash 2.29.
events.rationale: Hold short CORRA_2027-03. Afternoon oil is a supply impulse (conditional Hormuz plus Petroline), not demand destruction; Nasdaq at an intraday record is the risk-appetite tell. BoC cash 2.29 remains the easy outlier versus Fed 3.75-4.00 and a CORRA path that only gets H27 to 3.06. Labor 42.16 is over-discounted; do not cover the pay or flip to receiving. Residual US hike edge is thinner than the CAD catch-up still on the book.
